newsitem.title: ANTIGUA: CRICKET-ADAMS AND MURRAY DROPPED FROM WEST INDIES SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ADAMS AND MURRAY DROPPED FROM WEST INDIES SQUAD.

text.p: Middle-order batsman Jimmy Adams and wicketkeeper Junior Murray have been dropped from the West Indies squad for the third test against India starting at the Kensington Oval on Thursday.
Courtney Browne was named as wicketkeeper in the squad announced on Sunday and fast bowler Ian Bishop, who pulled out of the second test because of injury, was also included.
Trinidad paceman Mervyn Dillon, called in as a replacement for Bishop in the second test, has retained his place in the 13-man squad.
The first two tests in the five-match series were both drawn.

Squad: Sherwin Campbell, Stuart Williams, Shivnarine Chanderpaul, Brian Lara, Carl Hooper, Roland Holder, Courtney Browne, Franklyn Rose, Ian Bishop, Curtley Ambrose, Courtney Walsh (captain), Mervyn Dillon, Rawl Lewis.
